title: Fixed-floor smooth Class-II null-branch dichotomy
question: For the already fixed A6/A7 Class-II functional, what is the exact smooth pathwise zero-energy set, and can its active and singlet branches be separated before the open full-field tube, entropy and tightness estimates?
method: Keep the existing A6/A7 fixed-floor current definitions, positive production coefficient matrix, T-054 forward owner order and T-059/T-061 inverse locks unchanged.
Derive the Class-II coefficients from the hash-pinned A1 production functional manifest and use exact Fraction arithmetic for the Bloch and quadratic-form identities.

Enumerate the complete integer fixture grid [-2,2]^4 for the Bloch identity and coefficient-form zero set, then test pure-singlet, common-doublet-phase, rotating-doublet, plane-wave and quotient-derivative local fixtures.
Run a non-importing independent implementation, an eight-mutation hostile lane and the pinned Lean R461 algebraic kernel check.
Record the result as T0 claim-nonbearing evidence and use it only as the input branch partition for a future cutoff-uniform audit.
decision_scope: T0 exact smooth pathwise fixed-floor null-branch classification; no Gibbs measure, partition, tightness, regulator limit, physical branch, QFT or Yang--Mills inference
finding: Positive definiteness forces J_A=K_A=0 for every axis on a pathwise null field. The exact Bloch identity makes the zero-Bloch branch exactly z=0, while any active branch has a nonzero constant Bloch vector; the fixed positive floor then forces constant total rho and a constant rank-one doublet projector. Both branches are null, but an active common-phase plane wave has W_epsilon>0, so W_epsilon^{-1}(0) is not the pathwise null set. Primary, independent, hostile and Lean checks pass.
decision_reason: This is the next missing local lemma for the existing A6 full-field gate, not a replacement method or a new finite mobility table. It partitions the already fixed null set and exposes the exact conditional-mean firewall needed before any tube or entropy estimate.
boundary: R-461 classifies smooth pathwise null fields for the fixed-floor Class-II current on a connected domain. It does not classify the finite-cutoff Gibbs law, prove branch probabilities, establish partition convergence or tightness, remove the floor, select a physical empty branch, admit a source-owned dynamics, or close A6, A7, Pre-A, Sector A, QFT, Yang--Mills or mass gap.
evidence_level: T0 exact analytic null-branch dichotomy with executable primary/independent/hostile and Lean cross-checks
assumptions: The A6/A7 Pauli current definitions and fixed positive rho floor are the controlling definitions.
The coefficient matrix is positive definite and its concrete entries are derived from the hash-pinned A1 production manifest.
The domain is connected and the field is C1, so zero gradients give constant moments and a continuous nonnegative zero integral is pointwise zero.
The first two complex components carry the embedded Pauli representation; the third component is a singlet for these currents.
Lean checks the exact rational algebraic core only; the calculus and connected-domain implications remain analytic assumptions.
missing_assumptions: Cutoff-uniform tube probability and entropy estimates for both null branches under the correlated finite-cutoff Gibbs law.
Partition-function control, tightness and classification of subsequential bare measures.
A renormalisation prescription, rho-floor removal, infinite-volume limit and physical branch selection.
A source-owned Q3LOCK production generator/transfer/history contract and any QFT, Yang--Mills or mass-gap bridge.

adversarial_review.check: Could a zero Class-II quadratic form retain a nonzero current pair?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: positive a and positive determinant are checked exactly; the hostile semidefinite witness is rejected.

adversarial_review.check: Could a Pauli sign mutation preserve the squared identity while changing the projector?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: direct orientation witnesses catch the m2 and m3 sign mutations.

adversarial_review.check: Does constant rho alone imply nullity?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: the rotating-doublet control has constant rho but positive Class-II energy.

adversarial_review.check: Can q_A grad(rho) be dropped or given the wrong sign?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: the generic quotient fixture distinguishes the correct K derivative from the mutated expression.

adversarial_review.check: Can W_epsilon=0 stand in for pathwise Class-II nullity?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: the common-phase active plane wave is pathwise null with W_epsilon>0.

adversarial_review.check: Could this local lemma be promoted to concentration, continuum or physical status?
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: all downstream scope flags remain false and no tier changes.

next_action: Use the two-branch partition as an input to a new branch-aware cutoff-uniform tube/entropy audit. Do not infer concentration from the classification alone. Continue unchanged T-054 source-owner intake and T-059/T-061 observation-source locks.
stop_or_redesign: If a future branch probability estimate needs a regulator or domain not in this fixed-floor scope, freeze it as a new contract rather than silently extending R-461.
If uniform tube or entropy bounds fail for either branch, record the failure at the branch-specific gate and retain R-461 only as a finite pathwise classification.
If a source-owned dynamic contract appears, resume the existing owner order; do not substitute this static lemma for a generator, filtration or q-ledger.
